# @audio-samples/piano-mp3-velocity3

Salamander Grand Piano V3 MP3 samples by Alexander Holm.

## Wavy vendoring receipt

Wavy ships 15 unmodified `C` and `F#` samples from octaves 1–8 and pitch-shifts the nearest sample at playback. The vendoring receipt recorded on 2026-09-19 identifies package version **1.0.5**:

- Package archive: `https://registry.npmjs.org/@audio-samples/piano-mp3-velocity3/-/piano-mp3-velocity3-1.0.5.tgz`
- npm integrity: `sha512-HPacRGf2T9xkOcu2YZv8+uMgXQ1qI1G+UEkMWL31eK3a+gCNJC4CnQgNrmJl+dRO7jLL4HvDoy2N+DB9g2rSKw==`
- Original samples: [archive.org/details/SalamanderGrandPianoV3](https://archive.org/details/SalamanderGrandPianoV3)

The browser adjusts only playback rate and envelope; written note pitch, onset, and duration are not changed. [`../manifest.json`](../manifest.json) is the authoritative inventory of the shipped subset and records every file's byte length and SHA-256 hash. The upstream package reports a 4.93 MB full inventory; Wavy does not ship that full inventory.
